data.title: Hop Along the Number Line!
data.description: Practice adding numbers up to 20 by counting on using the number line.

challenges.instruction: Put your finger on the number 11. Now, make 4 big jumps to the right by counting on!
challenges.hint: Count each hop carefully as you move forward: 1, 2, 3, 4!

challenges.instruction: Put your finger on the number 8 and hop forward 5 spaces to find your new spot!
challenges.hint: Try counting out loud as you take each hop to the right from 8.

challenges.instruction: Put your finger on 11. Now, make 2 big hops to the right to see where you land!
challenges.hint: Count the hops one jump at a time, starting from 11.

challenges.instruction: Put your finger on 1, and make 5 big hops forward to the right. Where do you land?
challenges.hint: Count the hops one jump at a time, starting from 1.
